storyboardBeats.narration: Grinding when you brake is not "almost time." It is past time.
storyboardBeats.providerScene: Extreme macro, brake caliper gripping a rotor, studio-lit garage bay, shallow depth of field, slow push-in, sparks of reflected light off brushed metal, moody teal-and-amber practical lighting, cinematic automotive commercial look, 9:16 vertical framing

storyboardBeats.narration: Squealing is usually the wear indicator doing its job — an early warning.
storyboardBeats.providerScene: Close-up of a brake pad off the vehicle, thin metal wear-indicator tab visible against worn friction material, hand-free rotating turntable reveal, soft key light, shallow DOF, 9:16 vertical framing

storyboardBeats.narration: Grinding is metal on metal. You are cutting into the rotor right now.
storyboardBeats.providerScene: Macro shot of a rotor surface with visible score-mark grooves, dim garage bay lighting shifting to harsher red-orange practical light, slow lateral dolly across the grooved surface, texture-forward, 9:16 vertical framing

storyboardBeats.narration: One is a brake job. The other is a brake job, plus rotors.
storyboardBeats.providerScene: Two brake rotors laid side by side on a clean shop workbench, one lightly worn, one deeply grooved, top-down comparison shot, even overhead light, slow pull-back, 9:16 vertical framing

storyboardBeats.narration: Send this to someone whose car is making one of these sounds. Nick's Tire and Auto — link in bio.
storyboardBeats.providerScene: Wide shot of a tire shop garage bay interior, bay door partially open to daylight, tools racked in the background, no readable signage or branding in frame, warm end-of-day light, static hold, 9:16 vertical framing
